capabilities: render collapsible file and folder trees from an fsview code block
filter and sort entries by extension, regex pattern, date, or size
open files and folders in Finder from the tree
turn existing inline-code paths into clickable mentions
configure global defaults for all blocks
disambiguation: Not a replacement for the vault file explorer; it browses folders anywhere on the computer from inside note code blocks.
extras: Desktop-only and macOS-oriented (links open in Finder); requires Obsidian 1.4+; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer only shows files inside the vault, so there is no way to browse, filter, or link to folders elsewhere on the computer from within a note.

relations.evidence: Like Dataview, but for files and folders anywhere on your Mac

summary: Renders an interactive, collapsible tree of any folder on your computer inside a note via an fsview code block, with Finder links.
